turns.text: Hey Lloyd, my coffee maker started leaking again. Any tips?
Usually, that's a worn-out gasket. Have you tried replacing the seal?
I just cleaned it. Anyway, I'm running some benchmarks on my local LLM setup. Perplexity on WikiText-2 for Q4_K_M was approximately 6.8, which seems decent.
That sounds reasonable for a 4-bit quant. How does the inference speed compare to the FP16 version?
Much faster, though I'm still tuning the context window. Did you check the weather for tomorrow?
Yes, it looks like light rain in the morning. Shall I suggest an indoor lunch spot?
Yes, please. Also, remind me to order more coffee filters.
Noted. I've added filters to your shopping list.
